1. If the family hates the school → the doctor loses the car

If the officer buys the sugar → the family hates the school

Conclusion claims: O → F

This is attempting to reverse the direction of the logical chain. This is the fallacy of affirming the consequent. Just because F → O doesn't mean O → F.

For example: If F is true, then O must be true. But if O is true, F could be true or false - there might be other reasons why O is true.
